dict.string: holdmap asks System Events to shut down this computer only after you review and confirm the shutdown action.
holdmap reads project files (package.json, Cargo.toml, .git) in your Documents folder to show which project and branch a port belongs to. It never changes them.
holdmap reads project files (package.json, Cargo.toml, .git) on your Desktop to show which project and branch a port belongs to. It never changes them.
holdmap reads project files (package.json, Cargo.toml, .git) in your Downloads folder to show which project and branch a port belongs to. It never changes them.
